coordinates.note: No source fetched this session gives a surveyed lat/lon for the specific KTeV hall on the Fermilab fixed-target beamlines. Following the same honest pattern already used for site:fermilab-main-campus (owned by another workstream) and site:cern-ecn3-north-area (this workstream), the campus-level OSM/Nominatim centroid for the whole Fermilab site is recorded here with a large precision_m and `confidence: uncertain`. Treat this as campus precision, not hall precision.

name: KTeV experimental hall, Fermilab
notes: facility:fermilab is owned by the fermilab-dune workstream; this record only references it.

Coordinates reuse the same honestly-approximate Fermilab campus point as site:fermilab-main-campus (a different, existing site record owned by another workstream) rather than duplicating a fresh geocoder lookup; see coordinates.note.

2026-09-17 fixed-target verification: `coordinates.kind` was `detector`, which is dishonest under A23 (a campus-grade point relabelled `detector` to satisfy the validator, which then passes silently instead of emitting the honest `coordinate-kind-approximate` warning). summary.plain: The Fermilab experimental hall where the KTeV experiment studied rare kaon decays and CP violation in the 1990s.
summary.technical: Fixed-target experimental hall on the Fermilab site (Batavia, Illinois) housing the KTeV (E799-II/E832) kaon spectrometer; no surveyed coordinate for this specific hall was found, so the Fermilab campus point is used at reduced precision.
